interpretation: The entry presents Geach's argument (P1: if tormenting the cat is bad, getting your little brother to do it is bad; P2: tormenting the cat is bad; so getting your little brother to torment the cat is bad) and states that it is valid. This is the datum every theory of moral language must answer for (Q-MORAL-LANGUAGE-VALIDITY); the expressivists accept it too and try to explain it. Attribution reading on a secondary witness: the claim records the position the entry reports, not a thesis of the entry's author. No primary text is pinnable (in copyright, no immutable open text).
